# `company.prepayment_links`

What each customer prepayment receipt is held for; the current link is the one nothing supersedes.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this link. |
| `receipt_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_prepayment_links_receipt | transactions.id | Sales receipt whose Customer Prepayment line took the money. |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_prepayment_links_customer | customers.id | Customer or job the money is held for: the receipt's own. |
| `work_document_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | ix_prepayment_links_document | work_documents.id | Customer-work document the money is held on (an accepted estimate, a work order or a sales order); null when it is held for the customer. |
| `supersedes_link_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | unique | — | prepayment_links.id | Earlier link of the same receipt this one replaces; null for the receipt's first. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp the link was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal that recorded the link. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface the link came through. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed the link. |
